Pinned permitted tool and package inventories
Original fixture manifest and independent expectations

Full UUID identity, rename and independent copy/edit

Relationship list edits and dangling targets

claim: Licence and provenance: Close F03 official SDK, Python, native closure and notice
gates; TOST stays scoped.
method: Inventory exact pins, hashes, enabled features, normal/build/target/optional
dependencies, native files and generated resources; review original licence and
notices.
pass_criterion: Every included file/component has recorded origin, version, licence and required
notices; zero unresolved policy exceptions; reviewer signs the inventory.
fail_criterion: Fail on any unmet pass condition. Missing prerequisites or timebox expiry are
not_run/inconclusive and prevent promotion.

claim: Maintenance and API containment: Contain SDK/Python version changes behind the
worker adapter.
method: Name a primary maintainer and backup; review release/security maintenance;
exercise one adapter upgrade or controlled API perturbation, then replace the
backend with a stub reader.
pass_criterion: Two named owners accept maintenance; all upgrade and exit edits stay behind the
adapter in at most 8 person-hours; zero upstream types in public domain APIs; a
documented vulnerability/upgrade response path exists.
fail_criterion: Fail on any unmet pass condition. Missing prerequisites or timebox expiry are
not_run/inconclusive and prevent promotion.

claim: MSRV, platform and domain portability: Native SDK is host-only; no browser SDK
claim is required or implied.
method: Check exact-feature adapter and fixture round trip on Windows x64, Linux x64 and
macOS x64/ARM64; check all F08 domain crates for wasm32-unknown-unknown on
workspace MSRV.
pass_criterion: All four native target checks and all domain WASM checks pass on Rust 1.95, or on
an explicitly owner-approved replacement MSRV; zero forbidden domain dependency
edges. An unavailable target is not run, preventing promotion.
fail_criterion: Fail on any unmet pass condition. Missing prerequisites or timebox expiry are
not_run/inconclusive and prevent promotion.

claim: Required composition and ownership: Use independent SDK reader processes rather
than the authoring stage cache.
method: Freeze hand-derived authored and composed outcomes for S03-S06; enumerate both
variant choices and both payload states; compare each to a fresh pinned SDK
process.
pass_criterion: Zero mismatches in required layer, over, activation, target-list and foreign-
composition outcomes; zero foreign overrides accepted, including through an owned
wrapper. Unsupported foreign composition fails capability even if the diagnostic
is safe.
fail_criterion: Fail on any unmet pass condition. Missing prerequisites or timebox expiry are
not_run/inconclusive and prevent promotion.

claim: Identity, copy and unknown-field preservation: SDK preservation must be
demonstrated through BeamCraft mutations.
method: Run identity/copy/unknown edits through save and fresh reopen; compare exact
binary64 values, IDs, authored opinions, immutable digests and untouched foreign-
file hashes.
pass_criterion: All complete UUIDv7 IDs survive rename; duplicates/short IDs are rejected; copy
gets fresh IDs and remapped owned links; copy shape edit leaves source unchanged;
zero unknown opinion losses; exact original foreign hashes; zero digest
mismatches.
fail_criterion: Fail on any unmet pass condition. Missing prerequisites or timebox expiry are
not_run/inconclusive and prevent promotion.

claim: Semantic conflicts and later live deltas: Layer strength cannot stand in for
semantic merge.
method: Use a frozen truth table for same-field edits, label/placement, shape-group
dependencies, delete/read, relationship changes and unavailable index; replay 100
deltas with duplicates and inject one gap and one stale-base event.
pass_criterion: Every truth-table conflict/independence result matches; dependencies are engine-
derived; unavailable index is DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE; 100 deltas apply exactly
once; duplicate replay changes no generation; gap/stale base stops application for
resnapshot; local conflicting edits remain recoverable.
fail_criterion: Fail on any unmet pass condition. Missing prerequisites or timebox expiry are
not_run/inconclusive and prevent promotion.

claim: Atomic publication and durable outcome: Worker installation cannot certify host
acceptance.
method: Build a disposable original revision bundle; inject failures before/after blob
persistence, manifest persistence, candidate validation, host decision recording,
root switch and worker installation; race two publishers on one expected head;
restart and query outcome.
pass_criterion: All 12 before/after failure points reopen exactly the old or new complete
revision; exactly one racing publisher accepts the head; accepted op_id replay
increments once; uncertain outcomes remain OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until proved;
unpublished workspace survives restart and is absent from published root.
fail_criterion: Fail on any unmet pass condition. Missing prerequisites or timebox expiry are
not_run/inconclusive and prevent promotion.

claim: Bounded untrusted input and offline isolation: Sanitize SDK/plugin discovery and
enforce private-pipe isolation.
method: Exercise each declared stage cap at maximum and maximum-plus-one, truncate every
byte position of a small fixture, and generate 1000 fixed-seed malformed cases;
deny network and unapproved plugin execution; monitor allocations, working set and
timeout externally.
pass_criterion: Zero panic/crash/escape/network/plugin execution or partial publication; every
over-limit case rejected before the prohibited allocation/traversal; every
malformed case completes within 5 seconds and 512 MiB; checked cumulative caps and
cycle detection are evidenced. External termination or unavailable cap enforcement
is a failure, not safe parsing.
fail_criterion: Fail on any unmet pass condition. Missing prerequisites or timebox expiry are
not_run/inconclusive and prevent promotion.

claim: Determinism and measured resource cost: Include Python and native startup in
recorded startup cost.
method: Record reference hardware/OS; perform 30 cold open-compose-save runs at each S11
size, including startup separately; regenerate fixed-ID outputs 20 times with
seeded order changes.
pass_criterion: Own output bytes/digests and canonical semantic snapshots identical in all 20
repeats; 10000-prim p95 open-compose-save at most 5 seconds and peak working set
at most 512 MiB; all smaller stages stay within the same ceilings. Cross-engine
bytes need not match.
fail_criterion: Fail on any unmet pass condition. Missing prerequisites or timebox expiry are
not_run/inconclusive and prevent promotion.
